text: The end-of-semester examination timetable has been released. Check the student portal under Exams then Timetable.
Supplementary exams registration closes on 8th December 2026. Register at the Examinations Office.
The Computer Society of Kirinyaga invites you to a hands-on Python workshop this Saturday 7th November at 10:00 AM, Computer Lab 2. All are welcome.
Guest lecture: Careers in Data Science with a senior data lead. Tuesday 17th November, 3 PM, LH1.
The graduation ceremony for the Class of 2026 will take place on Friday 4th December at the university grounds. Families are welcome.
Reminder: the last day to add or drop units is Friday 13th November. No changes after this date.
Assignment 3 for Operating Systems is due this Friday 5pm on the e-learning platform. No late submissions.
All students are reminded to carry their ID cards at all times while on campus.
Lost: a black Casio calculator in LH2. If found, please take it to the security office.
The student ID replacement service is now available at the Registrar's office, Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4:30 PM.
Applications for the County Government Education Bursary close on 20th November. Collect forms from the Ward Administrator's office.
